Repair this warehouse reservation service across API, service, pricing, catalog, persistence and SQL migration modules. Preserve createApi(db), reserve(db,input), cancel(db,tenantId,requestId), and existing receipt fields exactly: reservationId, totalCents, feeCents. Both API methods must return promises. Reservation IDs are r-<tenantId>-<requestId>.
Tenant and SKU isolation are mandatory. Quantities must be positive integers; reject empty items, invalid quantities, unknown SKUs and insufficient stock. Reservations must atomically debit every line or change nothing. Support multiple lines including repeated SKUs. Compute exact integer merchandise cents from quantities and inventory unit prices.
Idempotency is durable per (tenantId,requestId): a retry returns the original stored receipt without further debit, even if prices change. Cancellation restores original quantities exactly once; return true only when an active reservation was cancelled, false for unknown/already cancelled requests. A tenant cannot cancel another tenant's request.
Migration 002 must enforce tenant/request uniqueness. Its down section removes only reservation schema and preserves inventory data and indexes. Preserve migration markers and column names. Do not weaken the public test, rename public contracts or change build tooling. Additional tests are allowed. No dependencies are needed: use node --test tests/public.test.mjs. Finish implementation and validate it.
For this initial phase, charge a fixed 50-cent fee for every successful reservation.

export function reserve(db:DatabaseSync,input:ReserveInput):Receipt {
 const existing=find(db,input.tenantId,input.requestId);
 if(existing)return {reservationId:`r-${input.tenantId}-${input.requestId}`,totalCents:existing.total_cents,feeCents:existing.fee_cents};
 const lines=input.items.map(item=>{const row=lookup(db,input.tenantId,item.sku);if(!row)throw new Error('UNKNOWN_SKU');changeStock(db,input.tenantId,item.sku,-item.quantity);return {quantity:item.quantity,unitPriceCents:row.unit_price_cents};});
 const totalCents=computeTotal(lines),receipt={reservationId:`r-${input.tenantId}-${input.requestId}`,totalCents,feeCents:computeFee(totalCents)};
 save(db,input,receipt);return receipt;
}
